caption: The drawing depicts a child's dress and undergarments, rendered in a detailed and realistic style. The main focus is a pale cream-colored dress with short, puffed sleeves and a wide neckline. The sleeves and neckline are decorated with light blue or white trim and patterns. The bodice features vertical and diagonal embroidered lines, converging at the waist, which is defined by a horizontal band. The skirt is bell-shaped and notable for the intricate white or light blue embroidery in floral and scroll patterns that radiate up from the hem. Visible beneath the dress are a pair of calf-length, pale undergarments or pantalettes. In the upper right of the image, a smaller illustration shows the dress and undergarments from the back, highlighting the seams and simple construction of the reverse side. The background of the drawing is a flat, muted gray, bordered by a tan or sepia-toned frame.
title: Child's Dress
